headline: No API changes break the bot today and research was thin, so there are just two ideas, both from streak studies: let a broken clean-day streak be repaired, and show clean days per week so one bad day doesn't wipe the slate.

ideas.title: Repair a broken clean-day streak
ideas.why: Studies find a broken streak makes people quit, but a repair option softens that. After a tilted day, the next day can restore your /lessons streak if it is clean and you stop at half your trade cap. One bad day stops being a reason to give up on the rules.

ideas.title: Clean days this week next to the streak
ideas.why: Alongside the streak, /lessons and the 08:00 brief show 'clean days: 4 of last 7' and your best streak. A run of clean days can make you feel safe, so the line also says your caps stay the same however long the streak is.
